Wash the cell with distillate water before putting the solution by putting 
quantity of distillate water with grams of potassium hydroxide with small qty 
Lithium hydroxide (to save battery life and fixing the solution) in glass vessel 
and continue mixing, measure density, add distillate water in case of increasing 
of density or add potassium hydroxide in case of decreasing of density to reach

Put the battery out of service by coordination with shift engineer.

items: Wear the safety and healthy protective equipment.

Prepare the new cell by filling it with electrolyte 1.22 gm/cm3 
 up to the mark indicating maximum level as follows:

Wash the cell with distillate water before putting the solution by putting 
quantity of distillate water with grams of potassium hydroxide with small qty 
Lithium hydroxide (to save battery life and fixing the solution) in glass vessel 
and continue mixing, measure density, add distillate water in case of increasing 
of density or add potassium hydroxide in case of decreasing of density to reach 
1.22 gm/cm3

Charge the cell using suitable 2V charger, with great attention to the 
 temperature of the cell.
Put the battery out of service by coordination with shift engineer.

Connect a suitable insulated cable (bypass) with terminals clamps between 
 cells before & after the cell to be changed, take care of polarity to make the 
 voltage difference between point of disconnect and previous point equal zero.

Ensure that the cable of bypass is good connected because of working on direct 
 current.
Disconnect the old cell and remove it from its position.

Loose strap connecting between (cell 1), (cell 2) and between (cell 2), (cell 
 3).
Lift cell no. 2 and put the new cell in place.
Tight perfectly the loosen straps.
Place the battery back into normal operating condition.
Record the battery readings in the MRDS Form

Introduction
This document outlines procedures P1, 
 which performed to replace the defected cell by a new one, only 
 when it is necessary according to the measured values of the cells.

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance 
 staff carry the suitable safety ID category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work

Use

 and vise versa
